newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil exports $1.128 bln so far in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Brazil exports $1.128 bln so far in Jan.

text.p: Brazil has exported goods worth $1.128 billion so far in January, with average daily exports for the first two weeks of the month at a low $161.1 million, a Ministry of Industry and Commerce spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said exports in the first two working days of the month were $316 million and in the second week, which had five days, $812 million.
Exports in December totalled $3.789 billion, with a daily average of $189.5 million. The markets speculate that the country posted a December trade deficit of about $1.5 billion.
The trade balance for December and for the whole of 1996 is expected to be released later this week.
